host.description: Bare compute name (e.g. "bridge", not "bridge-01") of the vm that hosts this service.

pki.description: Name of the two-tier (mesh) PKI in pki.enc.yaml this service is a leaf member of. Its per-scope intermediate must exist for the service's scope (global service -> global; regional service -> every region).

mtls_files.description: opt-in: also project this service's own mesh leaf + trust bundle into its tmpfs and inject MTLS_LEAF_CERT_PATH/MTLS_LEAF_KEY_PATH/MTLS_TRUST_BUNDLE_PATH — for services running a raw mTLS plane outside the mesh (e.g. tunneller node-to-node forward). Default false: the mesh proxy is the sole leaf custodian and the service holds no cert material (ADR-0033).

reload.description: Optional ExecReload command the service uses to apply a renewed mesh leaf without downtime (e.g. "/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID" or "nginx -s reload"). When set, the renewal timer reloads the unit; when absent, it restarts.

ingress.description: Name of the ingress resource (same scope) whose nginx fronts this service's routes. Required when routes is non-empty; the ingress host and this service's host must share the same network when they differ.

health_probes_port.description: backend port this service serves health checks on. nginx surfaces it through the ingress's (or, for a gateway-listed service without ingress, the gateway's) public health port, demuxed strictly by the service FQDN (request Host header). When co-located it must differ from that public health port. Requires health_probe_paths (>=1).

health_probe_paths.description: exact request paths the health server proxies to health_probes_port (e.g. /healthz, /readyz) — any other path 404s at the health listener (allowlist-only, ADR-0034). Required when health_probes_port is set.

exposed_ports.description: ports the service binds that inforge opens on the host's private network only (never the public internet), for peer/service-to-service traffic; distinct from public ingress routes and from compute.firewall.inbound (which is public).

routes.description: typed inbound routes realized on the referenced ingress's nginx. Each route binds a public listen port; tls-termination routes may share a port (SNI demux). A forward port is single-service-exclusive but may coexist with tls-termination routes on the same port (nginx ssl_preread routes known SNIs to the terminators and the unknown SNI to the forward).

type.description: tls-termination: nginx terminates ACME TLS for the service's SNIs and reverse-proxies to target. forward: nginx stream-forwards the raw L4 connection to target with the PROXY protocol; the backend owns its TLS.

listen.description: public port the ingress nginx accepts traffic on (required; no default; must differ from target when co-located)

target.description: backend port the service listens on; nginx reverse-proxies/forwards to it over loopback (co-located) or the private network (cross-host). Required. A raw public port with no proxy belongs on the compute's firewall.inbound, not here.

vanity.description: extra public FQDNs (beyond the auto-derived <svc>.svc name) a tls-termination route serves. A bare token is env+region-scoped; a value with a dot or a {BASE_DOMAIN}/{ENV}/{REGION_SLUG} placeholder is a literal FQDN. Valid only on tls-termination (forward has no SNI).

mesh.description: east-west mesh exposure (ADR-0032): the loopback port peers reach this service on, and the callee-side allow list of who may call it. A pki: service without a mesh block can still make outbound mesh calls but exposes nothing inbound.

port.description: loopback backend port this service serves mesh traffic on (plain HTTP).

allowed_services.description: bare service names permitted to call this service over the mesh; include "gateway" to be reachable by daemon traffic through the north-south gateway.

public_paths.description: absolute path globs (ADR-0034: * = one path segment, trailing /** = any tail) exposed at the internet edge through a gateway that lists this service; also admitted from mesh peers. A gateway-listed service must declare at least one.

internal_paths.description: absolute path globs admitted from mesh peers only — never served by a gateway. A mesh callee must declare at least one path across public_paths and internal_paths (its endpoint surface is allowlist-only).

grants.description: permissioned access to Grantable resources (database/pki), materialized as env vars composed over the fields the resource publishes (ADR-0025). Topological (wires the service to a named resource), so it lives here, not in environment.yaml.

resource.description: <type>/<name> of the granted resource; type is database or pki. A global target uses a global/ name prefix (e.g. database/global/main).

permission.description: ro: read-only DB user / PKI verify (CA cert only). rw: read-write DB user / PKI issue (root signing key).

outputs.description: env-var name → template over {FIELD} placeholders scoped to this grant. A value-field template composes a string; a file-field placeholder resolves to the projected PEM's on-host path and must stand alone.
